name: eli5
description: Explain any topic like I'm 5: a dead-simple HTML picture explainer with big visuals and few words. Use $eli5 with a topic.

interface.longDescription: ELI5 turns a topic into a dead-simple HTML artifact with big visuals and very few words for someone who knows nothing about it.
defaultPrompt: Explain how DNS works with big pictures and few words.
Create an ELI5 HTML picture explainer for this topic.
